address: Bai Vong, Ham Ninh Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Ferry from Ha Tien around 185,000–300,000 VND (~$7–$12); from Rach Gia around 290,000–400,000 VND (~$11–$15)
hours: Ferries run during daylight hours; schedules change seasonally — confirm with Superdong or Phu Quoc Express before traveling
tip: If you arrive by ferry, a Grab or shuttle to Duong Dong takes about 30 minutes. Book your onward transport before you board the ferry in peak season.

name: Sao Beach (Bai Sao)
address: Sao Beach, An Thoi Ward, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free to enter; sun loungers, umbrellas, and water sports cost extra
hours: Open all day; best in the morning before the day-trippers arrive
tip: The island's most beautiful beach — a 7 km curve of powdery white sand and shallow turquoise water on the southeast coast, about 25 km from Duong Dong. The water is calmest in the dry season (November–April). Arrive before 9:00 AM for empty sand and the best light, and bring reef-safe sunscreen.

name: Sun World Hon Thom — Hon Thom Cable Car
address: Anh Duong Station, Sunset Town, An Thoi Ward, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Round-trip cable car including Sun World Hon Thom (Aquatopia water park and Exotica Village): 850,000 VND (~$33) per adult; 700,000 VND (~$27) for children 1–1.4 m; free for children under 1 m
hours: Cable car runs in two blocks, roughly 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00 daily, with a midday break; island attractions close around 16:45
tip: At 7.9 km, this is the world's longest three-wire sea-crossing cable car, and the 15-minute ride over the An Thoi archipelago is unforgettable. Cross in the morning block — you get about seven hours on the island for the same ticket, versus about three if you cross at 13:30. Some older guides still list 700,000 VND; the current 2026 price is 850,000 VND. Confirm the schedule on the day, as it changes with weather and maintenance.

name: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc
address: Bai Dai, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Standard ticket 950,000 VND (~$37) per adult; 710,000 VND (~$27) for children 100–140 cm and seniors 60+; under 100 cm free. One-day combo with VinWonders Phu Quoc: 1,500,000 VND (~$58) per adult
tip: Vietnam's first semi-wild safari park — an open zoo plus a bus ride through the safari section where rhinos, giraffes, and lions roam. Arrive at 9:00 for the first bus and the 9:30 flamingo feed, and allow at least 3 hours. It closes early, so do the safari in the morning and VinWonders next door in the afternoon.

name: VinWonders Phu Quoc
address: Bai Dai, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Standard ticket 1,050,000 VND (~$40) per adult; 800,000 VND (~$31) for children 100–140 cm and seniors 60+; under 100 cm free
tip: Vietnam's largest theme park, with six themed zones, a water park, a huge aquarium, and the evening Once show (usually around 19:00). The combo ticket with the safari next door saves 500,000 VND (~$19) versus buying separately. Grand World, the third site in the same northern corner, is free to enter and comes alive after dark.

name: Phu Quoc Prison (Coconut Tree Prison)
address: 350 Nguyen Van Cu Street, An Thoi Ward, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free entry; optional audio guides and on-site guides around 100,000–200,000 VND (~$4–$8)
tip: A sobering and important site — a former POW camp and Special National Historical Relic, about 28 km south of Duong Dong and 2 km from Sao Beach. The exhibits are graphic and the atmosphere is heavy, so pair it with the beach afterwards rather than before. Go in the morning session or after 13:30 to avoid the lunch closure.

name: Dinh Cau Night Market
address: Vo Thi Sau Street, Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free to enter; food stalls set their own prices
hours: Not verified — evening market, busiest roughly 17:00–23:00
tip: The island's main evening market, beside the Dinh Cau shrine at the mouth of the Duong Dong River. Grilled seafood, fruit shakes, souvenirs, and pearls — Phu Quoc is famous for its pearl farms, but buy from reputable shops, not the cheapest stall. Come hungry and haggle gently.

name: Ho Quoc Pagoda
address: Suoi Lon Hamlet, Duong To Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free entry; donations welcome
tip: The island's largest pagoda, on a hillside above the sea on the east coast between Duong Dong and Sao Beach. The view from the terrace at sunset is one of the best on the island, and the architecture is a calm contrast to the resort buzz. Dress modestly and keep your voice down.

name: Rach Vem — Starfish Beach
address: Rach Vem, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free to enter; beach restaurants set their own prices
hours: Open all day; best December to April, when the water is clearest
tip: A fishing village in the far north where bright red starfish rest in the shallow, crystal-clear water in the dry season. Wade in slowly, look but do not pick the starfish up — they die quickly out of water, and the best photos are taken with them in it. The road is rough in places; a car or a confident scooter rider is better than a bicycle.

name: Kiss Bridge (Cau Hon) — Sunset Town
address: Sunset Town, An Thoi Ward, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Not verified — check at the entrance
tip: Two curving bridge halves that almost meet over the sea, designed so the sun sets in the gap between them. It is the island's most photographed sunset spot — come 30 minutes before sunset for a good position, and stay for the Kiss of the Sea evening show in Sunset Town if you have the energy.

name: Long Beach (Bai Truong)
address: Long Beach, Duong To Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free; resort beach sections may charge for loungers
hours: Open all day; best at sunset
tip: A 20 km stretch of sand along the west coast, and the island's classic sunset beach. The section near Duong Dong has the bars and beach clubs; further south it gets quieter. In the early morning, watch the fishing boats coming in with the night's catch.

name: Xin Chao Restaurant
address: 121 Tran Hung Dao Street, Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Around 150,000–350,000 VND (~$6–$13) per person
hours: Not verified — check at the door
tip: A long-running seafood favorite on the main street, with a terrace overlooking the sea. The grilled squid, hotpot, and goi ca trich are the dishes to order. Prices are by weight for some seafood — confirm the price before they cook it.

name: Ra Khoi Restaurant
address: Tran Hung Dao Street, Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Around 150,000–350,000 VND (~$6–$13) per person
hours: Not verified — check at the door
tip: A popular local seafood spot on the main strip, known for its grilled fish and hotpots. Come at sunset and sit outside if you can get a table.

name: The Pepper Tree Restaurant (La Veranda Resort)
address: Tran Hung Dao Street, Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Not verified — fine dining, roughly 400,000–800,000 VND (~$15–$31) per person
hours: Not verified — check at the door
tip: The island's most elegant dining room, in the colonial-style La Veranda Resort on Long Beach. French-Vietnamese cooking, a proper wine list, and a garden setting — the right choice for a special night out.

name: JW Marriott Phu Quoc Emerald Bay Resort & Spa
address: Bai Khem Beach, An Thoi Ward, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Room rates vary by season — Not verified, check on Agoda or Booking.com
tip: The island's most spectacular resort, on the beautiful and sheltered Bai Khem beach in the south. The architecture — a whimsical French university theme — is unlike anything else in Vietnam. Best for a splurge stay.

name: La Veranda Resort Phu Quoc — MGallery
address: Tran Hung Dao Street, Duong Dong, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Room rates vary by season — Not verified, check on Agoda or Booking.com
tip: A colonial-style boutique resort right on Long Beach, a short walk from the night market. The Pepper Tree restaurant is on site, and the pool garden is one of the prettiest on the island.

name: Mango Bay Resort
address: Ong Lang Beach, Cua Duong Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Room rates vary by season — Not verified, check on Agoda or Booking.com
tip: An eco-friendly beachfront resort on quiet Ong Lang Beach, between Duong Dong and the north of the island. No TVs, no air conditioning in some rooms — just sea breezes, a good restaurant, and one of the island's best sunset spots. Best for couples who want to switch off.

name: Vinpearl Resort & Spa Phu Quoc
address: Bai Dai, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Room rates vary by season — Not verified, check on Agoda or Booking.com
tip: The big family resort in the north, next to VinWonders, the safari, and Grand World. If your trip is built around the parks, staying here saves hours of driving. Book a package that includes park tickets — it is usually cheaper than buying separately.

name: Vinmec Phu Quoc International General Hospital
address: Bai Dai, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Hospital fees vary — Not verified
tip: The island's main international-standard hospital, in the Vinpearl complex in the north. For minor issues, the clinics in Duong Dong are closer — ask your hotel for the nearest one. Travel insurance is strongly recommended, and for anything serious, medical evacuation to Ho Chi Minh City is the usual route.

name: Khai Hoan Fish Sauce Factory
address: 11 Hung Vuong Street, Duong Dong Town, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: About 60,000–100,000 VND (~$2–4) for a 250 ml bottle; larger bottles and gift sets cost more
hours: Not verified — sources list 7:00 AM–7:00 PM and 7:00 AM–8:00 PM
tip: Free entry, with tastings and a shop. Go in the morning, when staff have time to explain the process. The smell is strong — that is the point.

name: Khu Tuong Pepper Farm
address: Khu Tuong Hamlet, Cua Duong Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Free entry; black pepper about 200,000 VND (~$8) per kg, white pepper about 260,000 VND (~$10) per kg
tip: The island's largest pepper farm, GlobalGAP-certified. Best in harvest season, roughly December to March, when the vines are heavy with red berries. Buy pepper salt too — it is a favourite gift.

name: Bay Gao Sim Wine Factory
address: 124 Ba Muoi Thang Tu Street, Duong Dong Town, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: About 80,000–200,000 VND (~$3–8) per bottle
tip: The best-known sim wine maker on the island, close to the fish sauce factories — combine the two stops in one morning.

name: Duong Dong Market
address: 128 Bach Dang Street, Duong Dong Town, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province
price: Pepper about 35,000–75,000 VND (~$1–3) per 100 g; dried seafood priced by weight at the stall
hours: Not verified — sources list 6:00 AM–6:00 PM and 5:00 AM–12:00 PM
tip: Come just after sunrise for the liveliest market and the best dried seafood. Bring cash — stalls do not take cards.

name: Duong Dong Harbor

price: Not verified — check the current GetYourGuide listing before booking
hours: Not verified — evening departures, usually around 4:30–5:30 PM
tip: Confirm the departure point and pickup time when you book — it changes with the season and the weather.

name: Rach Vem Floating Village
address: Rach Vem, Ganh Dau Commune, Phu Quoc, An Giang Province

hours: Not verified — morning and afternoon sessions available
